connector.name: webfetch by firish
connector.registryDescription: Self-hosted web search for LLM agents: search -> fetch -> rank pipeline with semantic caching
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package webfetch-llm. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the firish account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BRAVE_API_KEY
env.description: Optional - adds Brave to the multi-engine fusion. DDG works with no keys at all.

env.name: SERPER_API_KEY
env.description: Optional - adds Serper (Google results) to the multi-engine fusion.

env.name: TAVILY_API_KEY
env.description: Optional - adds Tavily to the multi-engine fusion.

env.name: WEBFETCH_PROVIDER
env.description: Optional - search strategy: multi (RRF fusion of available engines, default), fallback (priority failover), or a single engine name like ddg.
